info.title: Reverie API
info.description: HTTP API for Reverie, a self-hosted ebook library manager. Generated from the server handlers; do not edit by hand.

post.description: Verifies the caller's current password and sets a new one, invalidating all of the caller's sessions including the one making this request. Returns 401 if authentication is missing and 422 if the current password is wrong, the new password fails the password policy, or the account has no local credential.

200.description: Password changed; all of the caller's sessions are invalidated.

422.description: Wrong current password, new password rejected by the policy, or no local credential

get.description: Resolves the given `id` values to author display names, for labelling a restored filter chip. Ids are scoped to the caller's own visible library and to the `author` credit role; an id the caller cannot see, or one that is not an author, is silently omitted rather than reported as missing. Requires at least one `id` and rejects more than 60. Returns 400 for a malformed `id`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 422 when `id` is missing or over the limit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Author ids to resolve, repeated (`?id=<uuid>&id=<uuid>`). Required
(empty is 422) and capped at [`MAX_RESOLVE_IDS`]; unknown or
out-of-scope ids are silently omitted rather than 404'd.

200.description: Resolved author labels for the requested ids

422.description: Missing id filter or too many ids

get.description: Returns author names credited on a manifestation the caller can see, ranked by prefix match against `q` and then by similarity. Only the `author` credit role is matched, not editors, translators, or narrators. Scoped to the caller's own visible library. Returns 400 for a malformed `limit`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 422 when `q` is empty or longer than 100 characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form typeahead text. Trimmed before matching; empty after
trimming, or longer than 100 characters, is rejected with 422.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows returned. Clamped to 1..=20 (default 10); never rejects.

200.description: Author names in use on a visible manifestation, ranked prefix-first then by similarity

get.description: Returns one page of the manifestations visible to the caller, filterable and sortable via query parameters. Fails with `400` when a filter or sort parameter is malformed, and `422` when the cursor is invalid or a filter exceeds its allowed value count.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort stack, JSON:API grammar: comma-separated whitelisted field
names (`title`, `author`, `created_at`, `pages`); a leading `-`
reverses that level to descending; order of appearance sets
priority (the first field is the primary key). An unwhitelisted
field, a repeated column, or more than three levels is a 400.
Omitted, this is `-created_at` (today's "recent" order).

parameters.name: author
parameters.description:
All-of author filter: every listed author id must be linked to
the work in the `author` role. A single `?author=<uuid>` is the
one-element case.

parameters.name: author_any
parameters.description: Any-of author filter: at least one listed author id is linked.

parameters.name: author_none
parameters.description: None-of author filter: no listed author id is linked.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: All-of genre filter: every listed genre name must be attached.

parameters.name: genre_any
parameters.description: Any-of genre filter: at least one listed genre name is attached.

parameters.name: genre_none
parameters.description: None-of genre filter: no listed genre name is attached.

parameters.name: mood
parameters.description: All-of mood filter: every listed mood name must be attached.

parameters.name: mood_any
parameters.description: Any-of mood filter: at least one listed mood name is attached.

parameters.name: mood_none
parameters.description: None-of mood filter: no listed mood name is attached.

parameters.name: tag_any
parameters.description: Any-of tag filter: at least one listed tag name is attached.

parameters.name: tag_none
parameters.description: None-of tag filter: no listed tag name is attached.

parameters.name: title_contains
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive, accent-insensitive substring match on the work
title.

parameters.name: title_eq
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact match on the work title (no wildcards).

parameters.name: title_ne
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact non-match on the work title.

parameters.name: subtitle_contains
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive, accent-insensitive substring match on the work
subtitle.

parameters.name: subtitle_empty
parameters.description:
`true` keeps only rows with no subtitle; `false` keeps only rows
that have one.

parameters.name: isbn_13_contains
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the manifestation ISBN-13.

parameters.name: isbn_13_eq
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact match on the manifestation ISBN-13.

parameters.name: isbn_13_empty
parameters.description: `true` keeps only rows with no ISBN-13; `false` only rows with one.

parameters.name: pages_gte
parameters.description: Lower bound (inclusive) on page count.

parameters.name: pages_lte
parameters.description: Upper bound (inclusive) on page count.

parameters.name: pages_empty
parameters.description: `true` keeps only rows with no page count; `false` only rows with one.

parameters.name: created_at_gte
parameters.description:
Lower bound (day-inclusive) on the added date, ISO 8601 calendar date.
A query parameter arrives as a string, so the value is parsed through
[`filters::iso_date_opt`], which accepts `YYYY-MM-DD` and nothing else;
a malformed date fails deserialization and is a 400.

parameters.name: created_at_lte
parameters.description: Upper bound (day-inclusive) on the added date, ISO 8601 calendar date.

parameters.name: status_any
parameters.description:
Any-of reading-status filter. Each value is a `reading_status` wire
name or the `unread` pseudo-value (no status set); a row qualifies
when it matches at least one.

parameters.name: status_none
parameters.description: None-of reading-status filter: excludes rows matching any value.

parameters.name: rating_gte
parameters.description: Lower bound (inclusive) on the caller's rating (1 to 5).

parameters.name: rating_lte
parameters.description: Upper bound (inclusive) on the caller's rating (1 to 5).

parameters.name: rating_empty
parameters.description: `true` keeps only rows the caller has not rated; `false` only rated rows.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Quick-search text: narrows the current result set to rows whose
title or full-text vector matches, within the active sort order.
Case- and accent-insensitive. A filter, not a ranked search (that
lives at `/api/v1/search`).

200.description: Paginated list of visible books

Link.description: RFC 8288 next-page link; emitted with rel="next" when more rows remain

422.description: Invalid cursor or too many filter values

get.description: Returns detail for one manifestation, including work-level prose and a metadata-version summary. A manifestation hidden from the caller is reported as `404` rather than leaking its existence.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Book detail

404.description: Not found or RLS-hidden

get.description: Streams the full-size cover image for a manifestation as `image/jpeg` or `image/png`, with a strong `ETag` and a day-long `Cache-Control`, for the web UI. Requires authentication (401) via session cookie, device token or OIDC bearer token, returns 304 when `If-None-Match` matches the current `ETag`, and 404 when the manifestation is missing, hidden from the caller, or has no cover.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Cover image stream (`image/jpeg` / `image/png`); Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400; carries a strong ETag

304.description: Not Modified — the request's If-None-Match matched the cover ETag

404.description: Manifestation missing, RLS-hidden, or coverless

get.description: Streams the thumbnail cover image for a manifestation as `image/jpeg`, with a strong `ETag` and a day-long `Cache-Control`, for the web UI. Requires authentication (401) via session cookie, device token or OIDC bearer token, returns 304 when `If-None-Match` matches the current `ETag`, and 404 when the manifestation is missing, hidden from the caller, or has no cover.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Thumbnail image stream (`image/jpeg`); Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400; carries a strong ETag

304.description: Not Modified — the request's If-None-Match matched the cover ETag

404.description: Manifestation missing, RLS-hidden, or coverless

get.description: Returns the editable metadata span for one manifestation, matching what the corresponding PATCH accepts. Available to adult accounts only. Fails with `404` when the manifestation is missing or hidden from the caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: The editable metadata span, matching what PATCH accepts

ETag.description: Strong entity-tag hashing this response body. Echo as If-Match on PATCH /api/v1/books/{id}/metadata

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden (existence-not-leaked)

patch.description: Applies a manual operator edit to a manifestation's metadata; each touched field is recorded as a new metadata version. Requires an `If-Match` header; fails with `428` when it is absent and `412` when it does not match. Available to adult accounts only. Fails with `400` when `If-Match` is malformed or refused by policy, `422` when the body has no populated fields or a value fails parsing, and `404` when the manifestation is missing or hidden.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Exactly one quoted strong entity-tag, as returned in a prior GET or PATCH response's ETag header. Opaque content follows the full RFC 9110 8.8.3 grammar, obs-text included. The * wildcard, entity-tag lists, weak tags, and repeated instances of this field are refused with 400. Required: absent means 428; unequal means 412

requestBody.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent fields are unchanged, `null` clears (except `title`)

200.description: Manual edit recorded as a `manual` metadata version and promoted to canonical (or cleared); body carries the applied value and version pointers per field

ETag.description: Strong entity-tag hashing every PATCH-modifiable field, reflecting the state after this write

400.description: If-Match is malformed, or carries a form this API refuses by policy: the * wildcard, an entity-tag list, a weak tag, or a repeated header instance

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden (existence-not-leaked)

412.description: If-Match does not match the manifestation's current metadata ETag

ETag.description: Current entity-tag, so the caller can resync without a follow-up GET

422.description: No populated fields, ISBN/date parse failure, or attempt to clear title. Evaluated only after If-Match has matched, so a stale tag returns 412 instead

get.description: Returns the caller's reading state for one book; all-null fields mean the book is unread. Fails with `404` when the manifestation is missing or hidden from the caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Caller's reading state; all-null fields mean unread (no row yet)

ETag.description: Strong entity-tag hashing every PATCH-modifiable field; echo as If-Match on a protected write

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden (existence-not-leaked)

patch.description: Applies a partial update to the caller's reading state for one book, such as status, rating, or notes. Requires an `If-Match` header; fails with `428` when it is absent and `412` when it does not match the caller's current entity-tag. Fails with `400` when `If-Match` is malformed or refused by policy, `422` when the body has no populated fields or a value is out of range, and `404` when the manifestation is missing or hidden.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Exactly one quoted strong entity-tag, as returned in a prior GET or PATCH response's ETag header. Opaque content follows the full RFC 9110 8.8.3 grammar, obs-text included. The * wildcard, entity-tag lists, weak tags, and repeated instances of this field are refused with 400. Required: absent means 428; unequal means 412

requestBody.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent fields are unchanged, `null` clears

200.description: Reading state after the patch and any transition stamps

ETag.description: Strong entity-tag hashing every PATCH-modifiable field, reflecting the state after this write

400.description: If-Match is malformed, or carries a form this API refuses by policy: the * wildcard, an entity-tag list, a weak tag, or a repeated header instance

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden (existence-not-leaked)

412.description: If-Match does not match the caller's current reading-state ETag

ETag.description: Current entity-tag, so the caller can resync without a follow-up GET

422.description: Empty patch, rating outside 1-5, or notes over 10000 characters. Evaluated only after If-Match has matched, so a stale tag returns 412 instead

get.description: Returns the most recent ingestion batches, newest first, with per-batch outcome counts. Clamped to 1 to 100 batches (default 20). Admin only. Returns 400 for a malformed `limit`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 403 when the caller is not an admin.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max recent batches to return; clamped to 1..=100, default 20.

200.description: Most-recent ingestion batches, newest first. Admin only.

get.description: Returns aggregate library statistics: manifestation and work counts, storage usage by format, validation and enrichment status breakdowns, and metadata coverage. Admin only. Returns 401 when unauthenticated and 403 when the caller is not an admin.

200.description: Library-wide aggregate health metrics. Admin only.

get.description: Returns the count of manifestations visible to the caller in each enrichment state: pending, in progress, complete, failed, and skipped. Not available to child accounts. Returns 401 when unauthenticated and 403 for a child account.

200.description: Per-status manifestation counts under the caller's RLS context

get.description: Returns genre names attached to a manifestation the caller can see, ranked by prefix match against `q` and then by similarity. Scoped to the caller's own visible library. Returns 400 for a malformed `limit`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 422 when `q` is empty or longer than 100 characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form typeahead text. Trimmed before matching; empty after
trimming, or longer than 100 characters, is rejected with 422.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows returned. Clamped to 1..=20 (default 10); never rejects.

200.description: Genre names in use on a visible manifestation, ranked prefix-first then by similarity

post.description: Synchronously scans the ingestion directory and returns per-outcome file counts: processed, failed, and skipped. Admin only. Returns 401 when unauthenticated and 403 when the caller is not an admin.

200.description: Scan complete; per-outcome file counts. Admin only.

post.description: Runs the enrichment pipeline synchronously against the manifestation without saving any change, and returns the diff it would make. Per-source failures are listed in the response rather than failing the request. Not available to child accounts. Returns 401 when unauthenticated, 403 for a child account, and 404 when the manifestation is missing or not visible to the caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Diff of changes an enrichment pass would make; per-source failures are listed, not fatal

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden

post.description: Re-queues the manifestation for a fresh enrichment pass. An idle manifestation is reset to pending immediately; one with an active run is re-queued once that run completes. Not available to child accounts. Returns 401 when unauthenticated, 403 for a child account, and 404 when the manifestation is missing or not visible to the caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

202.description: Re-run scheduled: an idle manifestation is reset to pending for the background worker's next poll; one with an active run is re-queued when that run completes

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden

get.description: Returns the metadata review queue for one manifestation, newest first; the list is empty when the manifestation is missing or hidden from the caller. Available to adult accounts only, returning `403` for a child account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Metadata version rows for the manifestation, newest first (empty when the manifestation is missing or RLS-hidden)

post.description: Promotes a pending metadata version to canonical for a manifestation; accepting an ISBN change may trigger a re-match against other works. Available to adult accounts only. Fails with `404` when the version does not belong to the manifestation or is hidden from the caller, and `422` when the stored value fails parsing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Version promoted to canonical; accepted ISBN changes may re-match the work

404.description: Version not found for this manifestation, or RLS-hidden

post.description: Locks a metadata field against future automated enrichment writes; locking an already-locked field is a no-op. Available to adult accounts only. Fails with `422` when `entity_type` is not `work` or `manifestation`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

post.description: Marks a pending metadata version as rejected. Available to adult accounts only. Fails with `404` when the version does not belong to the manifestation or is hidden from the caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Version marked rejected

404.description: Version not found for this manifestation, or RLS-hidden

post.description: Restores a prior metadata version as canonical for a field, or clears the field entirely when no version is given. Available to adult accounts only. Fails with `404` when the manifestation or version is missing or hidden from the caller, and `422` when the field cannot be cleared or the stored value fails parsing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Field reverted to the given version, or cleared when version_id is null

404.description: Manifestation or version missing, or RLS-hidden

422.description: Field cannot be cleared or stored value fails parsing

post.description: Removes a lock on a metadata field, allowing future automated enrichment writes to resume. Available to adult accounts only. Fails with `404` when no matching lock exists, and `422` when `entity_type` is not `work` or `manifestation`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manifestation id

200.description: Lock removed

404.description: No matching lock

get.description: Returns mood names attached to a manifestation the caller can see, ranked by prefix match against `q` and then by similarity. Scoped to the caller's own visible library. Returns 400 for a malformed `limit`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 422 when `q` is empty or longer than 100 characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form typeahead text. Trimmed before matching; empty after
trimming, or longer than 100 characters, is rejected with 422.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows returned. Clamped to 1..=20 (default 10); never rejects.

200.description: Mood names in use on a visible manifestation, ranked prefix-first then by similarity

get.description: Returns distinct publisher values recorded on a manifestation the caller can see, ranked by prefix match against `q` and then by similarity. Scoped to the caller's own visible library. Returns 400 for a malformed `limit`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 422 when `q` is empty or longer than 100 characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form typeahead text. Trimmed before matching; empty after
trimming, or longer than 100 characters, is rejected with 422.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows returned. Clamped to 1..=20 (default 10); never rejects.

200.description: Distinct publisher values in use on a visible manifestation, ranked prefix-first then by similarity

get.description: Returns the top hybrid-ranked manifestations matching a free-text query, with highlighted snippets. Fails with `400` on a malformed query parameter and `422` when the query is missing, empty, or exceeds the length limit.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form query text. Empty / whitespace-only → 422; over
[`MAX_Q_LEN`] chars → 422.

200.description: Top hybrid-ranked search results

get.description: Returns series names attached to a manifestation the caller can see, ranked by prefix match against `q` and then by similarity. Scoped to the caller's own visible library. Returns 400 for a malformed `limit`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 422 when `q` is empty or longer than 100 characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form typeahead text. Trimmed before matching; empty after
trimming, or longer than 100 characters, is rejected with 422.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows returned. Clamped to 1..=20 (default 10); never rejects.

200.description: Series names in use on a visible manifestation, ranked prefix-first then by similarity

get.description: Returns the series identity plus its works in order, each with the manifestations visible to the caller. Returns 401 when unauthenticated and 404 when the series does not exist, has no linked works, or none of its works has a manifestation visible to the caller.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Series id

200.description: Series identity + ordered works with visible manifestations

404.description: Series not found, has no linked works, or no work has a visible manifestation under the caller's RLS context (existence-not-leaked)

get.description: Returns the currently persisted application settings, including the fields that only take effect after a process restart and the timestamp of the last successful live-reload. Admin only. Returns 401 when unauthenticated and 403 when the caller is not an admin.

200.description: Current persisted settings plus reload health. Admin only.

put.description: Applies a JSON Merge Patch to the application settings: fields absent from the body are left unchanged, and at least one field is required. Returns the updated settings and whether the change needs a process restart to take effect. Admin only. Returns 401 when unauthenticated, 403 when the caller is not an admin, and 422 for an empty patch, a malformed body, or invalid field values.

requestBody.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent fields are unchanged; at least one field is required

200.description: Updated settings. `restart_required` is true when a changed field only takes effect after restart. Admin only.

422.description: Empty patch, malformed body, or invalid field values

get.description: Returns one page of the caller's own shelves, ordered with system shelves first then by name. Fails with `400` on a malformed query parameter, `422` on a malformed cursor, and `401` when unauthenticated.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`; absent
returns the first page.

200.description: One page of the caller's shelves, system shelves first then by name

Link.description: RFC 8288 next-page link; emitted with rel="next" when more rows remain

post.description: Creates a new shelf for the caller. Available to adult accounts only, returning `403` for a child account; fails with `422` when the name is missing or empty.

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

get.summary: Get a shelf with its items
get.description: Returns a shelf's identity plus one page of its items in position order. Restricted to shelves the caller owns; fails with `404` when the shelf does not exist or belongs to another user. Fails with `400` on a malformed query parameter and `422` on a malformed cursor.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Shelf id

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Opaque items cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`;
absent returns the shelf with its first page of items.

200.description: Shelf identity plus one page of ordered items

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110); echo as If-Match on reorder

Link.description: RFC 8288 next-page link; emitted with rel="next" when more items remain

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

delete.description: Deletes a shelf owned by the caller. Available to adult accounts only, returning `403` for a child account; system shelves cannot be deleted and return `409`. Fails with `404` when the shelf does not exist or belongs to another user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Shelf id

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

patch.description: Renames a shelf owned by the caller. Available to adult accounts only, returning `403` for a child account; system shelves cannot be renamed and return `409`. Fails with `404` when the shelf does not exist or belongs to another user, and `422` when the name is missing or empty.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Shelf id

200.description: Renamed shelf

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

put.description: Rewrites the full ordering of items on the caller's shelf. Requires an `If-Match` header carrying the shelf's current entity-tag; fails with `428` when it is absent and `412` when it does not match. Fails with `404` when the shelf does not exist or belongs to another user, and `422` when the supplied list does not exactly match the shelf's current items.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Shelf id

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong entity-tag from a prior shelf response; weak validators (W/"...") are rejected

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's new updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

412.description: If-Match does not match the shelf's current updated_at

422.description: Malformed If-Match, or items list does not exactly cover the shelf

post.summary: Add an item to a shelf
post.description: Appends a manifestation to the end of the caller's shelf; adding one already on the shelf is a no-op. Fails with `404` when the shelf does not exist, belongs to another user, or the manifestation is not visible to the caller, and `422` when the body is missing or malformed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Shelf id

204.description: Item appended at the end (no-op if already on the shelf); shelf ETag bumped

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's new updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing / not owned, or manifestation not visible to the caller

delete.summary: Remove an item from a shelf
delete.description: Removes a manifestation from the caller's shelf. Fails with `404` when the shelf does not exist, belongs to another user, or the manifestation is not on the shelf.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Shelf id

parameters.name: manifestation_id
parameters.description: Manifestation to remove

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's new updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing / not owned, or item not on the shelf

get.description: Returns tag names attached to a manifestation the caller can see, ranked by prefix match against `q` and then by similarity. Scoped to the caller's own visible library. Returns 400 for a malformed `limit`, 401 when unauthenticated, and 422 when `q` is empty or longer than 100 characters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form typeahead text. Trimmed before matching; empty after
trimming, or longer than 100 characters, is rejected with 422.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows returned. Clamped to 1..=20 (default 10); never rejects.

200.description: Tag names in use on a visible manifestation, ranked prefix-first then by similarity

get.description: Returns the caller's active device tokens, without the plaintext credential or its stored hash. Returns 401 if authentication is missing.

200.description: The caller's active device tokens, hash and plaintext elided

post.description: Issues a device token for the caller and returns its Bearer credential exactly once; only its hash is persisted afterwards. Returns 401 if authentication is missing, 403 if a requested scope exceeds the caller's role, and 422 for an invalid `name`, an empty scope set, an invalid `expires_in_days`, or if the caller already has 10 active tokens.

201.description: Token created. The `token` field is the Bearer credential, returned exactly once — only its SHA-256 hash is persisted.

403.description: Caller's credential lacks the write scope, or a requested scope exceeds the caller's role ceiling

422.description: Name empty / longer than 255 characters after trim, scope set empty, expires_in_days not one of 30/60/90/365, or the per-user cap of 10 active tokens is reached

delete.description: Revokes one of the caller's device tokens by id. Returns 401 if authentication is missing, 403 if the caller's credential lacks the write scope, and 404 if the token does not exist, belongs to another user, or is already revoked.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Token row id

403.description: Caller's credential lacks the write scope

404.description: Token does not exist, belongs to another user, or is already revoked

get.description: Returns every user, oldest first, capped at 500 rows. Admin only. Returns 401 if authentication is missing and 403 if the caller is not an admin.

200.description: All users, oldest first, defensively capped at 500 rows. Admin only.

post.description: Creates an account with an administrator-typed initial password, for the administrator to relay out of band. Admin only. Returns 401 if authentication is missing, 403 if the caller is not an admin or is a child, 409 if the email is already in use, and 422 for an invalid email or a password rejected by the password policy.

422.description: Invalid email, or password rejected by the policy

patch.summary: Update a user's name or email
patch.description: Updates the target user's `display_name` and `email` using JSON Merge Patch: an absent field is unchanged, and an explicit `null` clears `email` but is rejected for `display_name`. Neither field invalidates the target's sessions. Admin only. Returns 401 if authentication is missing, 403 if the caller is not an admin, 404 if the target does not exist, and 422 for a null or empty `display_name`, an invalid `email`, or an `email` already in use.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Target user id

requestBody.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent fields are unchanged; explicit `null` clears `email` and is rejected for `display_name`

200.description: Updated user. Does not invalidate the target's sessions (neither field gates access). Admin only.

404.description: Target user does not exist

`*_version_id` slot. Each slot binds a single

overridden.

URI reference identifying the specific request, when available.

effect after a process restart.

which at the maximum page size would dominate the response body many

Version to restore; `null` clears the canonical pointer AND the
canonical column.

Authorization role assigned to a [`crate::models::user::User`].

Drives `auth::middleware::CurrentUser::require_admin` and
`auth::middleware::CurrentUser::require_not_child`; renaming a variant
compile-errors at every consumer, eliminating the silent-lockout

Credential capability, one of the authorization axes alongside [`Role`]
(identity gating) and ownership (resource axis).

The variants are declared in ascending capability order, so the derived

command-palette UI needs: a kind tag for grouping, identifiers for
navigation, a short display label, and an optional `ts_headline`

Cover thumbnail URL for `book` results — relative path under

when the hit kind has no cover surface (future author/series
variants).

Result kind. Currently always `"book"`; `"author"` and

`ts_headline` snippet from the work's title+description with
ASCII STX (`\u{0002}`) / ETX (`\u{0003}`) start/stop markers
around matched terms. Control codepoints, not valid UTF-8 text,

Tag identifying which entity a [`SearchHit`] points at. Serialised

`series.sort_name` (collation key — surfaced so the UI can

when the membership row has a null position.

One work within a series. Includes every manifestation of the work

Manifestations of this work visible to the caller. Empty when

position.description:
`series_works.position`; `None` when the membership row has a
null position.

Fields map 1:1 to the singleton row columns. The struct is held in
`AppState` behind an `Arc<RwLock<Settings>>` and refreshed via
LISTEN/NOTIFY + 60-second fallback poll.

(`updated_at` is transaction-start time and can move backwards across

Settings fields whose changes only take effect after a process

One `{ status, count }` bucket in a breakdown array. `status` is the

Per-field sparse update body for `PATCH /api/v1/books/{id}/metadata`.

Encodes RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch semantics via
`serde_with::rust::double_option` (per
`docs/adr/0009-backend-auxiliary-crates-axum-extra-serde-with-and-subtle.md`):
* absent key → `None`         → leave field unchanged.
* key = `null` → `Some(None)` → clear the canonical value.
* key = value → `Some(Some(v))` → set the canonical value.

`cover` is not yet operator-editable from this endpoint — cover
promotion happens via a separate file-upload path.

Per-role contributor replace/clear. Absent = unchanged; `null` clears
author, editor, and translator together (pure RFC 7396 member removal).
Handled separately from the other fields — not part of [`Self::populated`].

Full replacement genre list. Absent = unchanged; `null` or `[]`
clears. Handled separately from the scalar fields; not part of
[`Self::populated`].

manifestation_identifiers.description:
Manifestation-level external identifiers keyed by scheme (e.g.
`{"googlebooks": "zyTZAAAAYAAJ"}`). Same per-entry set/clear semantics
as `work_identifiers`.

moods.description:
Full replacement mood list. Absent = unchanged; `null` or `[]`
clears. Handled separately from the scalar fields; not part of
[`Self::populated`].

pages.description: New page count. Absent = unchanged; `null` clears; must be positive.

pub_date.description:
New publication date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Absent = unchanged; `null`
clears.

tags.description:
Full replacement tag list. Absent = unchanged; `null` or `[]`
clears. Handled separately from the scalar fields; not part of
[`Self::populated`].

title.description:
New title. Absent = unchanged; `null` is rejected (canonical title
is NOT NULL).

work_identifiers.description:
Work-level external identifiers keyed by scheme (e.g.
`{"openlibrary": "OL45804W"}`). Each entry independently sets its
scheme's single slot; a `null` entry clears it. Absent (or `null`)
leaves all work-level identifiers unchanged. Handled separately from
the scalar fields — not part of [`Self::populated`].

fields.description: Keyed by patched field name, including `contributors.<role>` keys.

ValidationStatus.description:
Outcome of structural validation for a single manifestation.

Wire-format invariant: variants serialise to the lowercase forms declared
in the `#[serde]` and `#[sqlx]` attributes. `clean`, `repaired`, and
`degraded` are all stored-and-served outcomes on one quality tier — `clean`
means *no issues found*, not *the only valid state*. Unknown DB variants
fail decode loudly at the boundary instead of coercing into a string.

`#[non_exhaustive]` is deliberately absent: `reverie_api` is a single
lib+bin crate with no foreign downstream matching on this enum, and the
loud-decode-failure design *wants* the compile error when a
[`ValidationOutcome`](crate::services::epub::ValidationOutcome) variant is
added without a matching arm — `non_exhaustive` would suppress exactly that.
